verdict.rationale: Mem0 provides an official MCP server exposing memory tools so agents can add/search/update memories mid-conversation on their own, plus a CLI and REST API supporting add/search/list/update/delete operations, and even agent self-signup flows for autonomous account/API key creation. This covers the full CRUD lifecycle invoked by the agent itself, though evidence is entirely vendor-documentation based. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that an agent autonomously invokes delete/update mid-conversation (not just add/search), and third-party confirmation of MCP tool reliability in production agent loops.
